map.上线前先把正则放进真实样本里试：确认既不会漏掉合法输入，也不会误匹配非法输入，再: Before shipping, try the regex against real samples: confirm that it misses no valid input and matches no invalid input, then write it into the code.

map.若出现卡死或耗时过长，检查是否有嵌套量词导致的灾难性回溯: If it freezes or takes too long, check whether nested quantifiers cause catastrophic backtracking
map.解决办法是避免嵌套量词、改用更具体的字符类，或用原子组/独占量词（视引擎支持）: Avoid nested quantifiers, use more specific character classes, or use atomic groups or possessive quantifiers (depending on engine support)
map.用户可控的正则应设超时保护: User-controllable regexes should have a timeout
map.加 `g` 标志遍历所有匹配。: Add the `g` flag to match across all lines.
map.很可能是灾难性回溯：嵌套量词（如 (a+)+）在遇到长而不匹配的字符串时，尝试次: It is most likely catastrophic backtracking: nested quantifiers (such as (a+)+) attempt an exponentially growing number of steps on a long non-matching string, pegging the CPU. The fix is to avoid nested quantifiers, use more specific character classes, or use atomic groups or possessive quantifiers (depending on engine support). User-supplied regexes should have a timeout.
